notes.title: Update including a new heist Royale Multiplayer Map
notes.notes:
Mafia Pigs has been live for over a week now, and we already have thousands of activations. Lots of fun from players too. Thank you for playing the game, those that already did! 

We’ve just updated the game on Steam to add a few additional features and bug fixes in. So if you haven’t tried it yet, there’s never been a better time! New in this version:

Controller fixes so gamepad controllers now work fully. 

An all-new mission map for multiplayer, so you can now choose between two.

Guard AI fixes to make your lives just that little bit easier in a few places!

We highly recommend the multiplayer version of the game. It’s easy to get into and a lot of fun. So grab a couple of friends and compete to see who can pull off the biggest Heist!
